title: Technical Spec
description: A technical spec (TECH): a cross-cutting technical rule on code style, structure, testing, or security

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the spec.

description.description: Optional narrative: rationale for the rule and what it protects against.

include_on_spex_init.description: When true, `spex init` adds this spec to every repository's tech-specs list. Defaults to false.

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable acceptance criteria. Order by commitment level: MUST, then MUST NOT, then SHOULD, then SHOULD NOT, then MAY.

items.description: A single verifiable acceptance criterion, provable by automated checks or AI. Starts with a commitment level.

checks.description: Automated checks that verify the spec's acceptance criteria.

description.description: Optional human-readable summary of what the check verifies.

type.description: How the check is executed: regexp matches file contents, glob matches file paths, script runs a command.

severity.description: Severity when the check fails. Defaults to error when omitted.

include.description: Glob patterns that narrow this check's file set to matching paths. When omitted, all non-ignored files are in scope.

exclude.description: Glob patterns that remove matching paths from this check's file set.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the contents of each in-scope file.

negate.description: Inverts the check. When false (default), a match is a violation (forbidden). When true, a file with no match is a violation (required).

pattern.description: Path glob matched against the paths of in-scope files.

negate.description: Inverts the check. When false (default), a matching path is a violation (forbidden). When true, the absence of any matching path is a violation (required).

oneOf.title: script check
oneOf.description: Runs `scripts/<name>.sh` for each matched file from the repository if present, otherwise from spex.

oneOf.title: command check
oneOf.description: Runs `scripts/<name>.sh` once per repo from the repository if present, otherwise from spex.

examples.title: No secrets in source code
examples.description: Hardcoded credentials, API keys, and tokens in the repository are a common source of security breaches. Secrets must be provided through environment variables or a dedicated secrets manager so they are never committed to version control.
acceptance_criteria: MUST NOT commit API keys, passwords, or tokens to the repository
MUST load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager at runtime
SHOULD fail CI when a secret-scanning check detects credentials in a diff

checks.name: hardcoded-secrets
checks.description: Detect potential hardcoded secrets in source
